name: LG UltraFine Ergo 32UN880
notes: The standard MCCS input command (VCP 0x60) only blanks the screen briefly on this model, and its capabilities string lists no USB-C input. LG's alternative command (source 0x50, VCP 0xF4) works. While showing one input the monitor ignores DDC/CI on all others, so each computer can only switch away from itself. If the newly selected input has no signal, the monitor returns to an active input after a few seconds. The EDID name is the generic 'LG HDR 4K', so match on product code, not name.
